verdict.rationale: Measuring model precision and recall and running shadow-mode trials is a fair question for a fraud-decisioning product, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of either capability. The test teams it does document are an isolated test tenant whose orders are excluded from model learning, not shadow evaluation of a new model on live traffic. Decision Center's checkpoint policies are an adjacent rules feature with no documented measurement or shadow mode.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can measure the model itself — precision and recall on my traffic, shadow-mode trials of new models or rules before they take over decisions
